# Texas Smart Cities Project

> > A smart cities initiative by TACC and Good Systems at the University of Texas at Austin, leveraging IoT sensors and AI to monitor fire incidents, air quality, and urban sustainability.

The project combines real-time data from sources like PurpleAir air quality sensors and AFD fire incident reports with advanced visualization tools. It supports research partnerships with organizations like Pecan Street and the City of Austin to address urban challenges through data-driven solutions.

## Key Topics

- TACC (Texas Advanced Computing Center)
- Good Systems
- University of Texas at Austin
- Internet of Things (IoT)
- Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
- Real-time Fire Incident Monitoring
- Air Quality and Smoke Forecasting
- PurpleAir Sensors
- Urban Sustainability
- City of Austin Partnership
- Pecan Street
- Smart City Data Visualization
- Energy and Water Usage Analytics
- AFD (Austin Fire Department)
- Smart City Hackathon

## Overview

- [Smart Cities Project](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/): Homepage for Texas Smart Cities Project using IoT and AI solutions

## Fire Incident Monitoring & Air Quality

- [Active Fire Incidents Map](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/FireIncidentMap.html): National fire tracker with real-time monitoring and air quality data
- [Active Fire Incidents Map - 3D Visualization](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/3D/): 3D visualization of active fires with PurpleAir smoke forecast data
